Retrieve activity provenance via molecule_dictionary to compound_records to docs to activities to assays to target_dictionary. Join compound_structures to obtain canonical_smiles. Filter for target CHEMBL203 and standard_type IC50 with standard_units nM. Return all rows without deduplication or limit.
